author: "Jinghao Zhang"

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
```

## Data Import

```{r}
restaurant_raw = read_csv(
  "data/restaurant_raw.csv.gz",
  col_types = cols(
    CAMIS = col_character(),
    ZIPCODE = col_character(),
    PHONE = col_character()
  )
) |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
dim(restaurant_raw)

n_distinct(restaurant_raw$camis)
```

## Missing Values

```{r}
missing_summary = restaurant_raw |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    percent = round(missing / nrow(restaurant_raw) * 100, 2)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(missing))

knitr::kable(missing_summary)
```

## Duplicate Records

```{r}
sum(duplicated(restaurant_raw))

restaurant_clean = restaurant_raw |>
  distinct()

dim(restaurant_clean)
```

## Date Conversion

```{r}
restaurant_clean = restaurant_clean |>
  mutate(
    inspection_date = mdy(inspection_date),
    grade_date = mdy(grade_date),
    record_date = mdy(record_date)
  )

sum(
  restaurant_clean$inspection_date == as.Date("1900-01-01"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

## Data Quality Check

```{r}
restaurant_clean |>
  count(boro, sort = TRUE)

restaurant_clean |>
  count(grade, sort = TRUE)

sum(
  restaurant_clean$latitude == 0 |
  restaurant_clean$longitude == 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```
## Handling Invalid Values

```{r}
restaurant_clean = restaurant_clean |>
  mutate(
    boro = na_if(boro, "0"),
    latitude = na_if(latitude, 0),
    longitude = na_if(longitude, 0),
    inspected = inspection_date != as.Date("1900-01-01")
  )

table(restaurant_clean$inspected, useNA = "ifany")
```

## Valid Inspection Records

```{r}
inspection_records = restaurant_clean |>
  filter(
    inspected == TRUE,
    !is.na(inspection_type)
  )

dim(inspection_records)
```

## Inspection Consistency Check

```{r}
inspection_check = inspection_records |>
  group_by(camis, inspection_date, inspection_type) |>
  summarise(
    score_count = n_distinct(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    grade_count = n_distinct(grade, na.rm = TRUE),
    boro_count = n_distinct(boro, na.rm = TRUE),
    cuisine_count = n_distinct(
      cuisine_description,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

inspection_check |>
  summarise(
    total_inspections = n(),
    score_conflicts = sum(score_count > 1),
    grade_conflicts = sum(grade_count > 1),
    boro_conflicts = sum(boro_count > 1),
    cuisine_conflicts = sum(cuisine_count > 1)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
violation_data = inspection_records |>
  filter(!is.na(violation_code)) |>
  select(
    camis,
    dba,
    boro,
    zipcode,
    cuisine_description,
    inspection_date,
    inspection_type,
    violation_code,
    violation_description,
    critical_flag,
    score,
    grade,
    latitude,
    longitude
  )
```

# Check missing values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(violation_data))
```

# Check duplicate rows
```{r}
sum(duplicated(violation_data))
```

## Inspection-Level Dataset
```{r}
inspection_data = inspection_records |>
  group_by(camis, inspection_date, inspection_type) |>
  summarise(
    dba = first(dba, na_rm = TRUE),
    boro = first(boro, na_rm = TRUE),
    zipcode = first(zipcode, na_rm = TRUE),
    cuisine_description = first(cuisine_description, na_rm = TRUE),
    score = first(score, na_rm = TRUE),
    grade = first(grade, na_rm = TRUE),
    latitude = first(latitude, na_rm = TRUE),
    longitude = first(longitude, na_rm = TRUE),
    violation_count = sum(!is.na(violation_code)),
    critical_count = sum(
      critical_flag == "Critical" & !is.na(violation_code),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dim(inspection_data)
```

## Missing Values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(inspection_data))
```


## Violation Counts

```{r}
summary(inspection_data$violation_count)

summary(inspection_data$critical_count)

sum(
  inspection_data$critical_count >
    inspection_data$violation_count
)
```

## Inspection Years

```{r}
inspection_data |>
  mutate(year = year(inspection_date)) |>
  count(year) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Study Period

```{r}
inspection_final = inspection_data |>
  filter(year(inspection_date) %in% 2024:2026)

violation_final = violation_data |>
  filter(year(inspection_date) %in% 2024:2026)

dim(inspection_final)
dim(violation_final)
```

## Final Consistency Check

```{r}
sum(inspection_final$violation_count) ==
  nrow(violation_final)
```

## Export Cleaned Datasets

```{r}
write_csv(inspection_final, "data/inspection_final.csv")

write_csv(violation_final, "data/violation_final.csv")
```
